beats.beat: The company operates in two segments: infrastructure creation and operating a ready-mix concrete plant.
Contracts are won through a tender process: the client floats a tender, a pre-bid meeting is held, bids are submitted, and the lowest quote typically wins.
Major clients include Western Railways, Central Railways, MRVCL, MCGM, MMRDA, etc. Western Railway has been a client since 2006.
Revenue from key customers was 57% of total revenue in FY2018.
The order book is heavily concentrated on Western Railway (52% of orders on hand).
Products include railway platforms, station buildings, gauge conversion, bridge construction (various types), and bituminous/concrete roads.

business.heading: What the company does
business.purpose: Explain the two business segments, how contracts are won, key clients, revenue concentration, and products.

beats.beat: Revenue from operations declined from ₹8,661.35 lakhs in FY2014 to ₹6,053.05 lakhs in FY2018, with a peak of ₹9,021.12 lakhs in FY2015.
Net profit after adjustments was volatile: ₹95.95 lakhs (FY2014), ₹78.36 (FY2015), ₹32.63 (FY2016), ₹15.86 (FY2017), and ₹314.66 (FY2018).
Profit before interest, depreciation and tax (EBITDA) fluctuated: ₹784.46 lakhs (FY2014), ₹945.78 (FY2015), ₹783.31 (FY2016), ₹676.19 (FY2017), and ₹928.80 (FY2018).
Long-term borrowings decreased from ₹586.63 lakhs (FY2014) to ₹133.09 lakhs (FY2018). Short-term borrowings increased from ₹3,082.27 lakhs to ₹3,537.35 lakhs over the same period.
The company notes it had negative cash flows in recent years, which could impact its business.
Key ratios: EPS for FY2018 was ₹28.14, RoNW was 12.59%.

financials.heading: Financial performance
financials.purpose: Present revenue, PAT, EBITDA, debt trends over five years (FY2014-FY2018) from the restated financial statements.

beats.beat: Promoter: Amit Bholanath Mishra, who holds 74,95,476 equity shares (90.949% of pre-issue capital).
Other directors: Bharat Kumar Parmar, Shree Prakash Singh, Mukesh Pandey (each hold 300 shares).
Key management: Anchal Pachori (CFO, Chartered Accountant) and Mohit Soni (Company Secretary, ACS).
Related party transactions in FY2018: loans from KMP/Board ₹68.4 lakhs, director remuneration ₹57.7 lakhs, outstanding payables ₹324.3 lakhs.
No criminal cases filed against directors; none are willful defaulters.
Two companies promoted by the promoter were struck off by ROC due to non-operation.

beats.beat: The infrastructure sector contributes ~8% to India's GDP and is highly fragmented and working capital intensive.
The construction sector was valued at US$400 billion in 2015 and is expected to reach US$1 trillion by 2025.
Growth drivers include government programs like Smart Cities, AMRUT, Make in India, easing of FDI norms, and rising urbanization.
Headwinds acknowledged: slow pace of government projects, working capital crunch, changes in government policies.
Competition is from both organized and unorganized sectors.

industry.heading: Industry and market
industry.purpose: Describe the infrastructure sector, market size, growth drivers, headwinds, and competition as per the DRHP.

beats.beat: A B Infrabuild is a Mumbai-based infrastructure contractor that builds railways, bridges, and roads for government clients. It also operates a ready-mix concrete plant. The company is raising capital through an SME IPO to meet working capital needs.
The issue is a fresh issue of 44,28,000 equity shares of ₹10 each. There is no offer for sale.
Its largest customer, Western Railway, contributed 52% of orders on hand.

beats.beat: Dependence on Indian Railways: it contributed 57% of revenue in FY2018. Loss of this customer would significantly impact revenue.
Reliance on winning government tenders: revenues depend on acceptance of bids; failure to secure contracts could harm financial condition.
Geographical concentration: most operations are in Mumbai; adverse developments there could affect revenue.
Negative cash flow in recent years: sustained negative cash flow could adversely affect business.
Two companies promoted by the promoter were struck off by ROC, indicating past compliance issues.
